name: The Interview of Charity Kase
source:
Your name is Detective Denzel Poole, you've been hired by a shifty news reporter to interview a well known serial killer about their past, uncover hidden facts, mystery and who knows... maybe the truth would of been there all along!

[From [url=https://crustyclownflakes.itch.io/the-interview-of-charity-kase]Itch.io[/url]]

你的名字是丹泽尔·普尔侦探，一位狡猾的新闻记者雇用你采访一位著名的连环杀手，了解他们的过去，揭开隐藏的事实、谜团，谁知道呢……也许真相一直就在那里！
